mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals economic weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods following two consecutive quarters of declining GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5% and CPI is increasing, the real interest rate is high, which typically leads to a reduction in consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 5% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures are increasing and the unemployment rate is decreasing, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS is increasing and UNRATE is decreasing.
